name: State Street My2028 Municipal Bond ETF
name_en: State Street My2028 Municipal Bond ETF
desc: Under normal circumstances, SSGA Funds Management, Inc. (the “Adviser” or “SSGA FM”) invests at least 80% of the fund’s net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in investments the income of which is exempt from regular federal income tax. The fund primarily invests in municipal bonds maturing in the year 2028, which may include bonds with embedded issuer call options falling within that year. The fund is non-diversified.
